extra_vocab.zh: 公寓大廈、分戶出售的公寓
extra_vocab.en: a building with many homes that people buy and own separately
extra_vocab.note: 多益常見於房地產、租屋與廣告情境，通常指可個別購買的住宅單位，口語常縮寫成 condo。

example.en: Several new condominiums will open near the train station next year.
example.zh: 好幾棟新的公寓大廈明年將在火車站附近落成。

example.en: Each condominium unit comes with one parking space.
example.zh: 每個公寓單位都附一個停車位。

example.en: The condominium association meets on the first Monday of each month.
example.zh: 公寓管理委員會每個月第一個星期一開會。

example.en: The monthly condominium fee covers cleaning and security.
example.zh: 每月的公寓管理費包含清潔與保全。

example.en: Many young workers cannot afford to buy a condominium downtown.
example.zh: 許多年輕上班族買不起市中心的公寓。

examples.en: She bought a two-bedroom condominium near the city center.
examples.zh: 她在市中心附近買了一間兩房的公寓。

examples.en: The company rents a condominium for visiting managers.
examples.zh: 公司租了一間公寓給來訪的主管住。

examples.en: This new condominium has a gym and a swimming pool.
examples.zh: 這棟新公寓大廈有健身房和游泳池。

similar.diff: apartment 是一般的公寓，常用來出租；condominium 強調每一戶可以單獨買賣、由屋主持有。

example.en: The apartment is available for rent starting next month.
example.zh: 這間公寓下個月開始可以出租。

similar.diff: condo 是 condominium 的口語縮寫，意思一樣；廣告和日常對話很常用，正式文件多用全名。

example.en: Our firm sold three condos in the north district last week.
example.zh: 我們公司上星期在北區賣出三間公寓。

example.en: The landlord will fix the broken heater tomorrow.
example.zh: 房東明天會修壞掉的暖氣機。

example.en: Each tenant must pay rent by the fifth of the month.
example.zh: 每位房客必須在每月五號前繳房租。

example.en: We signed a two-year lease for the new office.
example.zh: 我們簽了新辦公室的兩年租約。

example.en: She applied for a mortgage to buy the condominium.
example.zh: 她申請了房貸來買這間公寓。

extra_vocab.zh: 大陸的、歐洲大陸的、歐式的
extra_vocab.en: of or related to a large area of land, or to the continent of Europe
extra_vocab.note: 多益最常見的用法是 continental breakfast（歐式簡便早餐，飯店常提供），也常用於 continental Europe 這類地理與市場說明。

collocations.zh: 歐式早餐（麵包、飲料等簡單早餐）

example.en: A continental breakfast includes bread, juice, and coffee.
example.zh: 歐式早餐包含麵包、果汁和咖啡。

example.en: Our products are popular in continental Europe and Asia.
example.zh: 我們的產品在歐洲大陸和亞洲很受歡迎。

example.en: A continental climate often has cold winters and warm summers.
example.zh: 大陸性氣候通常冬天寒冷、夏天溫暖。

examples.en: The room rate includes a light continental breakfast.
examples.zh: 房價包含簡單的歐式早餐。

examples.en: The sales team will tour continental Europe next month.
examples.zh: 業務團隊下個月會巡迴歐洲大陸各地。

examples.en: The city has a continental climate with hot summers.
examples.zh: 這個城市是大陸性氣候，夏天很熱。

confusable.diff: continual 是「不斷重複的」，拼法和 continental 很像，但和大陸無關。

example.en: The continual noise from the street made it hard to work.
example.zh: 街上不斷傳來的噪音讓人很難工作。

confusable.diff: continuous 是「持續不中斷的」，字形接近 continental，閱讀時容易看錯。

example.en: The machine ran in continuous operation for twelve hours.
example.zh: 這台機器連續運轉了十二個小時。

example.en: The international fair attracts buyers from over forty countries.
example.zh: 這場國際展覽吸引了來自四十多國的買家。

example.en: We plan to open an overseas office next year.
example.zh: 我們計畫明年開一間海外辦公室。

example.en: Sales in the northern region grew by ten percent.
example.zh: 北部地區的銷售成長了百分之十。

example.en: Domestic flights are cheaper than international ones.
example.zh: 國內航班比國際航班便宜。

derived.link: 最基礎的字。continental = continent + -al，「大陸的」，像 nation → national
inter-（之間）+ continental，跨越不同大陸的，像 international

senses.en: of a large area of land, not an island

example.en: Storms moved across the continental United States this week.
example.zh: 這星期暴風雨橫掃美國本土。

senses.en: of the continent of Europe, or in the style of Europe
senses.distinguish: 後面接 breakfast、food、style 這類字時，指歐式的；接 Europe 時，指歐洲大陸。

example.en: The hotel serves continental food, such as bread and cheese.
example.zh: 這間飯店供應歐式餐點，例如麵包和起司。
